caveats: Five Black women (Newsom, Quinn, Houcks, Miller, Williams) filed a federal civil rights suit in November 2023 against the Unified Government of Wyandotte County/Kansas City, Kansas, ex-detective Roger Golubski, former chiefs, and other detectives over decades of sexual assault/exploitation. Not a class action. Dismissed January 2025 by Judge Toby Crouse on Kansas's two-year statute of limitations (not on the merits); plaintiffs' appeal was still pending as of Dec 2025 sources, so 'dismissed' reflects the current disposition. Criminal: Golubski was federally charged (arrested Sept 2022, pleaded not guilty) but died by suicide Dec 2, 2024, the day trial was to begin, terminating the case — never convicted or acquitted, so 'charged'.
